integrity.main_claim_basis: Analytic proof by vacuum coefficient bounds and multivariate Vandermonde weighted-shift contractivity.
integrity.supplementary_check: 52,012 exact finite and illustrative numerical assertions in CHECKER.py; these do not establish the infinite assertion.

scientific_limitations: The exact supremum allows a separable infinite-dimensional coefficient Hilbert space; no fixed-matrix-size optimum is asserted.
The majorant sums individual coefficient operator norms, not operator absolute values or homogeneous-block norms.
Countably infinite-dimensional variable sets may give extended infinite majorants; the theorem is interpreted pointwise with this allowance.
Publication priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Exact coefficient-norm Bohr sets for operator-valued Drury–Arveson multipliers
